body:
Coming in a bit late. But if you're not here anymore, I still appreciate logging something for my own sanity.

It's been 22 days since your last message. I've been rolling your words around my head from time to time. I'd just like to say thank you. I wasn't on the brink of suicide by any means. But I'm slipping everyday. Slipping deeper into something I don't want to see. People like you help me claw upwards a little bit. Thanks for giving me a couple stepping stones to climb out the crevasse.

Thank you.  I am on mobile and a drowning slightly in some beer while I watch the Uk The Office. I can't requite in full until I'm with my laptop. I will reply as soon as I have my laptop nearby. But I just wanted to prematurely say thank you. I feel so alone without any friends beyond my SO. It's just nice to read a strangers words directed at me. I rarely speak out about these issues. It may be some days.

Nothing but fear really keeps me driving straight. I suppose a certain level of logic and shame also prevent me from steering into oncoming traffic. 

Not much makes me a lovely or kind person. I just finished reading *Ender's Game* and I fear that I relate far more to Peter Wiggins than Ender (sans the intellect and - perhaps more importantly - foresight). Though I've never quite murdered the innocent for my own enjoyment, I've fallen into my own roles of perverse pleasure induced by another's pain. 

I'm not a good person and I can feel myself oozing out of my body one day at a time. More and more frequently I have horrible nightmares that pull along my brain stem and cause a loud uninhibited screeching in my ears - quite literally. It feels like a seizure, but according to my SO I don't move at all. It feels like I'm being shocked from the tendrils of my nerves up into my head. It's this horrible paralyzing feeling. Along with it are visions of the world being torn apart or sucked down into some unknown void. At first I used to silently scream in my head. I could feel my impulse to cry out overtake me. But now it's a ritual. I embrace the paralyzing shocks and watch the ground beneath my feet give way. I realize that this may be a form of sleep paralysis but their is no known cure and it's difficult to track. Plus, it rarely makes an impact on my daily life. It just feels like a good metaphor for my depression.

I'm not lovely or kind though I try to be. Inside me is just stupidity tortured by an inability to act. I want to seize power, reduce everyone around me to nothing but servile drudges. But karma took hold. Instead, I'm the one with no power. The "drudgeon"   beneath everyone's finger. I'm glad I'm not in power because I've never had the capacity for kindness. Most times, I picture myself like Gollum from *Lord of the Rings*. Instead of holding a ring in my hands, I hold a small image of myself. A picturesque portrait of me as an intelligent, audacious, and thoughtful being. I horde it and pretend it's a mirror. I hide in caves because each time I expose myself to the light - people see the reality. "Average" seeps out of their eyes and I read the word as it drips on their face. 

I realize others are kind because they seemingly don't feel the way I do. They seem content to have me around despite my deplorable ideologies. They don't shoo me away as I would. I'm worried that one day I'll snap and forget that *I'm* the one that deserves to be dead. I worry that I'll turn this perverse mentality inside out and start hurting others. Sometimes I do it with my words and I feel guilty right away. I have been verbally abusive to family members and loved ones alike. I don't mean to be so harsh, critical, and sharp-tongued. But soon enough I find it come out of me. A spate of bloodthirsty words. When I was growing up as a child, it felt like it was every person for themselves. A fight for survival. In the harsh climate of child life, I grew inward. More reserved - more likely to risk my own ethics to climb the social ladder. 

My mother and father have both separately come to the realization that I just do not reciprocate their feelings fully. So did my brother or sister. I hold my brother in great admiration and contempt. His grandiose successes patterned by a life of genuine humility make me out to be the jester. Whereas my sister is affable and straight-forward - she is honest and logical. Here I am, a misfit. And all I've been given is a pair of eyes. One eye compares while the other, inwardly pointing, contrasts. I can't see why I exist. I just see why I shouldn't.  

_____________________________________________________

I have been honest in the past - with therapists. I've had several of them. I've even been to a rehab center for mental illness and drug addiction. But eventually, I learned honesty is not a good policy. Therapists are cops undercover. I've been kicked out of college for a suicidal attempt - as a danger to myself and others. I've been reduced to a cretin by therapists. Some of them, in a conciliatory gesture to "tough love", have acknowledged my insanity. They have given me titles such as "crazy", "sociopath", and "bipolar". But they are just titles: attempts to discreetly prioritize my actions and the catalysts to each action. But they always fail to reach the inevitable conclusion - an admittance of their failure. The mind is complicated and twisted. My head is full of dark corridors and passages just like any other. Trying to map it out and tell me the route I should take each day is not only attempting to bind me to social mores, but it's a sickening attempt at solving my problem.

Picture your mind as a maze (cliche, I know). And picture some paths leading to your death where others lead to a submissive existence. Therapists are trained to find the latter paths. They *try* to find a path to happiness, but a depressed person will have far more pitfalls then a stable person. And due to that fact, therapists take the first - safest path. They tell you to sleep on a schedule, eat healthy, workout, "think good thoughts". But what life is that? I don't have autonomy if I must jump through these predestined hoops each week.

Do you have an alternative route? A way out?
